select t4.seqno, org.objtype, org.orgid, IFNULL(t5.customer_name, org.orgid) as orgName, t4.title, t4.pub_date as pubDate, t4.source, t4.linkid, t4.cominfo from (select orgId, group_concat( DATE_FORMAT(objType) ORDER BY objType separator ',') AS objType from (select distinct '01' as objType, t2.issuer as orgId from PTL_SEC_POSITION t1 join FIN_PRODUCT t2 on t1.finprod_id = t2.finprod_id where t2.issuer is not null union select distinct '02' as objType, t2.financier as orgId from PTL_SEC_POSITION t1 join FIN_PRODUCT t2 on t1.finprod_id = t2.finprod_id where t2.financier is not null union select distinct '03' as objType, t2.manager as orgId from PTL_SEC_POSITION t1 join FIN_PRODUCT t2 on t1.finprod_id = t2.finprod_id where t2.manager is not null union select distinct '05' as objType, t2.sponsor as orgId from PTL_SEC_POSITION t1 join FIN_PRODUCT t2 on t1.finprod_id = t2.finprod_id where t2.sponsor is not null union select distinct '09' as objType, t2.invest_adviser as orgId from PTL_SEC_POSITION t1 join FIN_PRODUCT t2 on t1.finprod_id = t2.finprod_id where t2.invest_adviser is not null)
where objType in
#{objType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
group by orgId) org join INF_ORG_NEGATIVE_NEWS t4 on org.orgid = t4.org_no left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO t5 on org.orgid = t5.customer_id
org.orgId = #{orgId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and t4.pub_date >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d')
and t4.pub_date <= STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%Y-%m-%d')+1
order by pubDate desc , objtype

select distinct orgId, IFNULL(customer_name, orgId) as orgName from (select distinct t2.issuer as orgId from PTL_SEC_POSITION t1 join FIN_PRODUCT t2 on t1.finprod_id = t2.finprod_id where t2.issuer is not null union select distinct t2.financier as orgId from PTL_SEC_POSITION t1 join FIN_PRODUCT t2 on t1.finprod_id = t2.finprod_id where t2.financier is not null union select distinct t2.manager as orgId from PTL_SEC_POSITION t1 join FIN_PRODUCT t2 on t1.finprod_id = t2.finprod_id where t2.manager is not null union select distinct t2.sponsor as orgId from PTL_SEC_POSITION t1 join FIN_PRODUCT t2 on t1.finprod_id = t2.finprod_id where t2.sponsor is not null union select distinct t2.invest_adviser as orgId from PTL_SEC_POSITION t1 join FIN_PRODUCT t2 on t1.finprod_id = t2.finprod_id where t2.invest_adviser is not null) left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO on orgid = customer_id
where orgId like concat_ws('','%' ,#{orgStr, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , '%') or customer_name like concat_ws('','%' ,#{orgStr, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , '%')
